paragraphs: Rav Yehudah HaSabbar: Eruvin 72b, beginning. Rashi explains that he was called this for his sharpness. Arukh and Rif read HaSabbakh. Tosafot says Rabbenu Chananel reads Sabbakh, explaining it as a maker of netted head coverings, or after his town, since Joshua says “Middin and Sevakhah.” [The checked Joshua 15:61 reads Sekhakhah with kaf.] Rav Nachman said: Rav said: the law follows Rav Yehudah HaSabbar. I recorded a notable story about Ben Sevar under samekh; perhaps this is he.
